CLIP (with atom IDs): E04.009 | 00:24.00-00:28.00 | CAM | Slow push-in on the Mayor as the lamp flickers behind them.
E04.010 | 00:24.20-00:28.00 | ACT | the Mayor draws a short blade from a boot.
E04.011 | 00:24.40-00:27.44 | DLG | MARA (defiant, broken) | "I kept that light burning for eleven winters."
[Hard cut]
E03.005 | 00:06.00-00:12.00 | CAM | Close-up on the Mayor's hands gripping the rail.
E03.006 | 00:06.40-00:09.06 | DLG | MARA (broken, hopeful) | "Then let them come with their torches!"
E03.007 | 00:12.00-00:17.00 | CAM | Extreme close-up on the widow's eyes, wet with sea spray.
E03.008 | 00:12.20-00:17.00 | ACT | the widow grabs Tobin by the wrist.
E03.009 | 00:12.40-00:16.80 | DLG | TOBIN THE FERRYMAN (kind, urgent) | "The boat leaves at the turn of the tide. Be on it."
E03.010 | 00:17.00-00:22.00 | CAM | Tight shot on a silver ring glinting in candlelight.
E03.011 | 00:22.00-00:27.00 | CAM | Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.
E03.012 | 00:22.40-00:25.44 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (cold, silken) | "You were always too soft for this family."
E03.013 | 00:27.00-00:31.00 | CAM | Close-up on Mara's hands gripping the rail.
E03.014 | 00:27.20-00:31.00 | ACT | Mara draws a short blade from a boot.
E03.015 | 00:27.40-00:30.06 | DLG | SELENE (sweet, venomous) | "Search her pockets. She is a thief!"
E03.016 | 00:31.00-00:36.00 | CAM | Tight shot on a silver ring glinting in candlelight.
E03.017 | 00:31.40-00:34.44 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (triumphant, cold) | "Take the girl to the cells until morning."
E03.018 | 00:36.00-00:42.00 | CAM | Low angle on Selene framed against the lighthouse beam.
E03.019 | 00:36.20-00:42.00 | ACT | Selene tears the lace veil and lets it fall.
E03.020 | 00:36.40-00:39.44 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (O.S., cold, nervous) | "Order! I will have order in my hall!"
KEY REVEALS OF THE SHOW: R01 (E1): [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her
R02 (E2): [mock] The harbourmaster is revealed as Lord Corin Ashvale, thought drowned, and offers Mara a bargain
R03 (E3): [mock] On the wedding morning a poisoned cup forces Corin to choose between justice and Mara's family
R04 (E4): [mock] Selene spreads a rumour that Mara lit a false light to wreck a ship
R05 (E5): [mock] Tobin the ferryman reveals what he saw on the night of the feast
R06 (E6): [mock] The council votes to take the lighthouse from Mara
R07 (E7): [mock] Corin's past returns on a ship flying a black pennant
R08 (E8): [mock] Mara discovers her father's logbook hidden in the lamp room
